Anglogold Ashanti LTD (AU) Holder Ruffer Llp Lifted Its Holding; Bangor Savings Bank Stake In Apple (AAPL) Was Increased
June 15, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Bangor Savings Bank increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 16.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bangor Savings Bank bought 3,238 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 22,974 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.85 million, up from 19,736 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bangor Savings Bank who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.09B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.25% or $2.39 during the last trading session, reaching $188.41. About 17.11 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Ruffer Llp increased its stake in Anglogold Ashanti Ltd (AU) by 2.39% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ruffer Llp bought 78,453 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.95% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.37M shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $32.72 million, up from 3.29M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ruffer Llp who had been investing in Anglogold Ashanti Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.44 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 5.88% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $8.17. About 2.86 million shares traded. AngloGold Ashanti Limited (NYSE:AU) has declined 25.75% since June 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.32% the S&P500. Ruffer Llp, which manages about $2.04B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Thomson Reuters Corp (NYSE:TRI) by 39,107 shares to 14,715 shares, valued at $568,000 in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cisco Sys Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO) by 50,795 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 50,000 shares, and cut its stake in Tenaris S A (NYSE:TS).
